title: Visiting Carlsbad Caverns? Getting a Fresh Cut While You're in Town

card_text: In town for the caverns or a stretch of work? The shop is about 24 minutes from Whites City. How to book a cut on a short stay.
lede: If you're in the area for Carlsbad Caverns, my shop is in the city of Carlsbad at 303 S Halagueno St, about 20 miles and 24 minutes by car from Whites City at the caverns turnoff. Every cut is by appointment, so book a slot on Booksy from your phone before you drive in, and you'll be back on the road with a fresh cut.
Here's how to fit a haircut into a short stay, which service to pick, and what to know about my days and hours.

blocks.heading: In town, not at the caverns.
blocks.lead: A short drive from the turnoff.
paragraphs: The caverns sit outside the city, past Whites City. My shop is in Carlsbad itself, at {{address}}. If you're staying in town, it's likely a quick hop. If you're staying near the park, plan on about 24 minutes each way.
The visit page has the map link, my days and the payment options, all in one place. Save it on your phone before you head out, so the address is there when you need it.

blocks.heading: Fitting it in.
blocks.lead: Book first, then plan around it.

subsections.heading: Book before you drive
paragraphs: I cut by appointment only. Open Booksy, pick the service, and grab a time that fits your itinerary. If nothing works, text me at {{phone}} and ask before you drive over.

subsections.heading: Know my days
paragraphs: Saturdays run 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. I'm closed Wednesday and Sunday. Booksy shows the open times on every other day, so check there for the slot you want.

subsections.heading: Traveling over a holiday
paragraphs: I'm open on holidays at regular hours. Appointments on the holiday itself carry a {{holiday_fee}} holiday fee on top of the service.

subsections.heading: Paying
paragraphs: Payment is due after the service, and I take cash, card, Zelle and Cash App, so whatever you travel with works.

blocks.heading: A cut that travels.
paragraphs: A new chair in a new town can feel like a gamble, so take the guesswork out. Bring a photo of your usual cut on a day you liked it, and tell me what your barber back home normally does. I'd rather match what you're used to than surprise you a long way from home.

Tell me how you'll be living for the next while, too. A hotel sink and a small bag of travel products call for a cut that sits right with a little water and a comb. Long shifts under a hard hat call for something that still looks tidy at the end of the day.
If the trip has a photo in it, like a family picture at the park, book your cut early in the stay. That gives it a day to settle instead of looking freshly cut in every shot.

blocks.heading: Pick by the time you have.
blocks.lead: Three good fits for a visit.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The quickest full haircut on my menu: cut to your style and head shape, a straight razor cleanup at the neck, and styled. A good fit between sightseeing stops.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The haircut plus a beard trim or line-up, a hot towel finish and straight razor detailing. The one to book if a week on the road has let the beard go.

items.title: Straight Razor Beard Shave
items.body: A traditional wet shave with hot towels, shaving cream and a soothing aftershave, for when the beard is coming off entirely.

items.q: How far is the shop from Carlsbad Caverns?
items.a: From Whites City, at the turnoff for the caverns, it's about 20 miles and 24 minutes to the shop in Carlsbad.

items.q: Can I just stop in on my way through?
items.a: Every cut is by appointment. Book a time on Booksy first, and text me if you can't find one that fits.

items.q: I'm in town for work for a few weeks. Can I book more than one visit?
items.a: Yes. Booksy lets you pick each appointment ahead, so you can set your next cut before you leave the chair.

items.q: Is the shop open on weekends?
items.a: Saturdays from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM. Sundays I'm closed.
